headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 32
items: RESULT: France 3-0 Sweden — Kylian Mbappe's brace fires Les Bleus into the last 16
RESULT: Mexico 2-0 Ecuador — Quinones and Jimenez send hosts through at a roaring Estadio Azteca
RESULT: Ivory Coast 1-2 Norway — Erling Haaland's 86th-minute winner books Norway's spot
RESULT: Netherlands 1-1 Morocco — Morocco advance 3-2 on penalties; Germany also out, Paraguay win 4-3 on spot-kicks
TODAY: England vs DR Congo (12:00 PM ET, Atlanta); Belgium vs Senegal (4:00 PM ET, Seattle); USA vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (8:00 PM ET, San Francisco Bay)
NEXT: Spain vs Austria, Portugal vs Croatia & Switzerland vs Algeria headline Thursday's Round of 32 closers
GOLDEN BOOT: Messi & Mbappe level on 6 goals apiece; Haaland closes to within one on 5 after his Norway winner; Dembele and Vinicius Jr give chase on 4
